verification_steps.establishes: Every packaged input matches the SHA-256 in this manifest; every cited evidence digest with a digest identity is re-derived (S from the frozen object store, the historical revision from its named commit, E from the package file).
verification_steps.does_not_establish: That a digest-bound artefact is correct, complete or sufficient for the claim that cites it.

verification_steps.establishes: evidence/etp/claims.json validates against its schema with the Git-bound tree check at the frozen source commit.
verification_steps.does_not_establish: That any claim is true; the algebra checks typing and law, never truth.

verification_steps.establishes: courts/phase18/interop/check_receipts.py finds no R1-R5 problem in the tracked interop receipts and manifests, and every manifest log is present with the recorded digest.
verification_steps.does_not_establish: That the interop executions can be repeated here; the logs and receipts are re-verified, not re-run.

verification_steps.establishes: The ETP-3 instrument register validates (paths, versions, prerequisites, bindings) and every executable control whose external tool is installed passes and matches the register. Controls whose tool is absent are reported NOT_RUN, never PASS.
verification_steps.does_not_establish: A security result; instrument qualification is not a memory-safety, compatibility or constant-time proof.

verification_steps.establishes: The named hand-written quantities agree with their generated sources, and exemptions still apply to a live contradiction.
verification_steps.does_not_establish: Consistency of prose outside the registered checks.

verification_steps.establishes: Two independently initialised release builds and the distribution DSO are byte-identical from this source tree.
verification_steps.does_not_establish: Reproducibility on another machine, toolchain or architecture.
